name: root_domain strips subdomains to last two labels
spec_quote: Lower-cases and strips dots at the ends, then keeps the last two labels: `www.acme.com` → `acme.com`, `careers.jobs.acme.com` → `acme.com`.

name: root_domain keeps three labels for ccTLD under co/com/org/ac/gov/net
spec_quote: When the second-to-last label is one of co / com / org / ac / gov / net AND the last label has exactly 2 letters (a country code), keeps the last three labels: `www.acme.co.uk` → `acme.co.uk`, `shop.acme.com.au` → `acme.com.au`.

name: career_hosts derives careers/jobs hosts from company domain root
spec_quote: Company site → `['careers.<root>', 'jobs.<root>']` in that order, root = root_domain(site).
ambiguity_note: The spec calls the argument `site` and does not say whether a full URL with a path (as opposed to a bare host) is acceptable input; root_domain is only specified for hosts, so stripping the scheme/path is not explicitly stated.

name: clean_ident icims keeps careers-prefixed employee-facing label
spec_quote: **icims**: must be exactly `<label>.icims.com`. Null when the label is vendor infrastructure — `www`, `i`, `login`, `cdn` or `cdn` + digits, `images`, `assets`, `static`, `cookie-policy-scripts`, `api`, `app`, `careers`, `jobs` ... `careers-acme.icims.com` → kept

name: clean_ident icims rejects www vendor label
spec_quote: **icims**: must be exactly `<label>.icims.com`. Null when the label is vendor infrastructure — `www`, `i`, `login`, `cdn` or `cdn` + digits, `images`, `assets`, `static`, `cookie-policy-scripts`, `api`, `app`, `careers`, `jobs`

name: clean_ident taleo strips leftover url-encoded 2f prefix
spec_quote: a leading `2f` glued directly to a host label (a URL-encoded "/" left over, as in `2fhdr.taleo.net`) is removed.

name: clean_ident ultipro normalizes tenant upper-case and board id lower-case
spec_quote: **ultipro**: must be `<host>/<tenant>/JobBoard/<36-character board id>` ... Returned as `<host>/<TENANT upper-case>/JobBoard/<board id lower-case>`.

name: clean_ident ultipro without board id is null
spec_quote: Without the board id (e.g. `recruiting2.ultipro.com/abc123`) → null.

name: clean_ident oraclecloud rejects dev host
spec_quote: **oraclecloud**: must be `<label>.fa.<region>.oraclecloud.com`; null when the first label ends with `-dev`, `-test` or `-stage` (optionally followed by digits). ... `eofe-dev3.fa.us2.oraclecloud.com` → null.

name: clean_ident oraclecloud keeps production requisition host
spec_quote: **oraclecloud**: must be `<label>.fa.<region>.oraclecloud.com`; null when the first label ends with `-dev`, `-test` or `-stage` (optionally followed by digits). `eofe.fa.us2.oraclecloud.com` → kept

name: clean_ident teamtailor drops @site suffix
spec_quote: First: anything after an `@` is dropped (the `@site` suffix), whitespace and slashes at the ends are stripped, the result is lower-cased

name: clean_ident workable accepts plain slug and lower-cases it
spec_quote: **smartrecruiters / workable / jobvite / rippling**: ident is a slug: letters, digits, `_`, `-` only (starting with a letter or digit); null when it is vendor infrastructure (`api`, `embed`, `cdn-cgi`, `job-api`, `de-de`, `en-us`, `www`, …).

name: with_site appends @site only to successfactors/phenom/eightfold/teamtailor
spec_quote: For successfactors, phenom, eightfold and teamtailor whose ident is a string without `@`, the ident becomes `<ident>@<site>`. Every other pair is unchanged, order kept.

name: with_site empty site leaves list unchanged
spec_quote: Empty site → the list unchanged.

name: parse_icims takes title from h3, url up to /job, location from preceding field label, ignores foreign host
spec_quote:
each `` whose content is an optional `…` then `

Title

` is a posting; url = the href up to `/job` (query string dropped). location = the last `Location` field label ... within the 1,500 characters before the link, else "". Links to another host are ignored.

name: parse_icims posting without a preceding Location label gets empty location
spec_quote: location = the last `Location` field label (`LocationUS-VA-Arlington`) within the 1,500 characters before the link, else "".

name: parse_rmk joins base url, location from jobLocation, duplicate href collapses to one posting

args.page: Data AnalystArlington, VAData AnalystArlington, VA

spec_quote: `Title` (attribute order either way). url = base joined with the href. The same href twice → one posting. location = the first `class="jobLocation…"` element's text within 2,500 characters after the link, else "".

name: parse_phenom strips /apply on ATS applyUrl and falls back to baseUrl+job/id for non-ATS applyUrl
spec_quote: url = the job's applyUrl with a trailing `/apply` removed when applyUrl is on myworkdayjobs.com / myworkdaysite.com / greenhouse.io / lever.co / ashbyhq.com; otherwise `<baseUrl>job/<jobId>` ... location = cityStateCountry, else location, else "".

name: parse_phenom without eagerLoadRefineSearch returns empty list
spec_quote: No eagerLoadRefineSearch or broken JSON → [].

name: parse_oracle builds hcmUI url and skips entries without Id
spec_quote: postings = items[0].requisitionList; url = `https://<host>/hcmUI/CandidateExperience/en/sites/<site>/job/<Id>`, location = PrimaryLocation. Entries without Id skipped; no items → [].

name: parse_taleo joins JSON-list location with semicolons and skips entry without contestNo
spec_quote: each requisitionList entry with a column list and contestNo → title = column[0]; location = column[1] — when it is a JSON list string (`["A","B"]`) its items joined with "; "; url = `https://<host>/careersection/<cs>/jobdetail.ftl?job=<contestNo>&lang=en`.

name: parse_jazz reads location after map-marker icon
spec_quote: **parse_jazz(page, host)**: `Title`; location = the text after the next `fa-map-marker'>` within 600 characters, else "".

name: parse_jobvite builds jobs.jobvite.com url and strips tags from location cell
spec_quote: **parse_jobvite(page, slug)**: `Title`; url = `https://jobs.jobvite.com//job/`; location = text of the next `jv-job-list-location">…
ambiguity_note: The spec pattern is `href="/<slug>/job/<id>"`; it does not state whether a link whose href is an absolute URL not matching that relative form is ignored, so the second anchor's treatment is inferred (expected to be skipped) rather than quoted.

name: parse_rss decodes CDATA title and leaves location empty
spec_quote: **parse_rss(xml)**: each `<item>` with `<title>` and `<link>`; CDATA wrappers removed; location "".

name: postings returns empty for a system outside the supported list without a request
spec_quote: A system outside the list (icims, oraclecloud, successfactors, taleo, smartrecruiters, workable, jobvite, bamboohr, ultipro, eightfold, phenom, avature, jazzhr, rippling, breezy, recruitee, teamtailor, pinpoint) → [] without any request.

name: postings returns empty when clean_ident rejects the ident without a request
spec_quote: An ident clean_ident rejects → [] without any request. Never raises.

name: decide matches an icims posting by title and returns its url
spec_quote: A row whose systems include one of the systems above with an ident clean_ident accepts is searched like Workday / Greenhouse: a posting matching the title → code "match" with its url; none → code "no_match", system = that system.

name: decide reports no_match with the searched system when titles differ
spec_quote: none → code "no_match", system = that system.

name: decide falls back to other_system when the only system is unsupported
spec_quote: Systems whose ident clean_ident rejects, or systems not in the list (adp, paycom, …), are not searched; when nothing searchable is left → code "other_system", system = the first system in the list.

name: decide other_system names the first system in the list even when it is a rejected ident
spec_quote: Systems whose ident clean_ident rejects, or systems not in the list (adp, paycom, …), are not searched; when nothing searchable is left → code "other_system", system = the first system in the list.
